diseases.name: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Positional vertigo lasting seconds with canal-specific nystagmus. Posterior-canal Dix–Hallpike; canalith repositioning. No routine imaging or suppressants without atypical findings.

diseases.name: Ménière disease
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Spontaneous episodic vertigo 20 min–12 h, fluctuating sensorineural hearing loss and aural symptoms. Audiogram; exclude vestibular migraine. Intratympanic therapies selected for refractory episodes.

diseases.name: Acute unilateral vestibulopathy (vestibular neuritis)
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Continuous acute vestibular syndrome with unilateral hypofunction and no new cochlear deficits. Exclude posterior-circulation stroke; properly trained HINTS exam only in indicated patients. Early vestibular rehabilitation.

diseases.name: Idiopathic sudden sensorineural hearing loss
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Sudden sensorineural loss over ≤72 h. Exclude conductive loss, urgent audiometry and appropriate MRI/ABR; discuss time-sensitive systemic/intratympanic steroids and salvage per guideline.

diseases.name: Middle-ear cholesteatoma
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Keratinizing squamous epithelium in middle ear erodes ossicles, can cause labyrinthitis, facial palsy and intracranial infection. Otoscopy, CT temporal bone, diffusion MRI; usually surgical eradication.

diseases.name: Otosclerosis (otic-capsule otospongiosis)
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Abnormal otic-capsule remodeling fixes stapes, causing progressive conductive or mixed loss with typically normal tympanic membrane. Audiometry, acoustic reflexes; hearing aids or selected stapes surgery.

diseases.name: Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps
diseases.clinical_discriminator: ≥12 weeks sinonasal symptoms and objective inflammation/polyposis; type-2 eosinophilic inflammation is common but not universal. Saline, intranasal glucocorticoids, surgery or selected biologics.

diseases.name: Acute bacterial rhinosinusitis
diseases.clinical_discriminator: ≥10 days symptoms without improvement or double worsening support bacterial illness. Uncomplicated adults: watchful waiting with follow-up or amoxicillin with/without clavulanate 5–7 days where indicated; emergent orbital/intracranial signs.

diseases.name: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Often EBV-associated nonkeratinizing carcinoma with cervical nodes or unilateral middle-ear effusion. Endoscopic biopsy, EBER ISH, MRI staging; radiotherapy plus stage-adapted systemic treatment.

diseases.name: Laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Tobacco/alcohol-related squamous malignancy, often persistent hoarseness. Laryngoscopy with biopsy and site-specific TNM; early organ-preserving local therapy, multimodal approaches for advanced disease.

diseases.name: HPV-mediated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.clinical_discriminator: HPV-driven tumor commonly from palatine tonsil/base of tongue. p16 IHC surrogate in appropriate tissue and setting; HPV-specific staging and stage-directed surgery/radiation/systemic therapy.

diseases.name: Necrotizing otitis externa and skull-base osteomyelitis
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Invasive infection in diabetes/immunosuppression with severe nocturnal otalgia, canal granulation, cranial neuropathy. Culture/biopsy to exclude cancer, imaging, prolonged antipseudomonal therapy and multidisciplinary care.

diseases.name: Peritonsillar abscess (quinsy)
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Suppurative infection around palatine tonsil, presenting with unilateral pain, trismus, muffled speech, asymmetry. Prioritize airway when threatened; drainage, antibiotics for oral flora, hydration.

diseases.name: Vestibular schwannoma
diseases.clinical_discriminator: Benign Schwann-cell IAC/CPA tumor with asymmetric sensorineural loss, tinnitus and sometimes imbalance. MRI with gadolinium; observe, radiosurgery or microsurgery by growth, size and function.

evidence.limitation: Preceded by platinum and anti-PD-(L)1; excludes HPV-associated OPSCC; confirmatory benefit pending

clinical_update_nov_5_2026: FDA accelerated approved amivantamab/hyaluronidase-lpuj (EGFR/MET-directed) for adults with recurrent/metastatic head and neck SCC after progression on platinum chemotherapy AND anti-PD-(L)1; specifically NOT indicated for HPV-associated oropharyngeal SCC. Approval based on response rate/duration rather than verified long-term clinical benefit. Adverse effect concerns: administration reactions, ILD/pneumonitis, dermatologic, ocular, embryofetal.
